rationale: The candidate reads as a coherent low, rectilinear mass with a recognizable dominant bar and a notch-derived threshold, so the overall gesture is legible and repairable. It is not over-fragmented and the silhouette has some restraint, but the visible void logic is weak: the access edge is acknowledged only minimally and there is no truly public, occupiable court or undercut that clearly serves the neighborhood-living brief. The mass also leans toward a sealed, generic plate with sculpted top and side cuts, which keeps it from fully expressing the required active ground threshold or a stronger section-based public sequence. The references consistently point to courtyard/bridge/terrace organizations, which this candidate only partially reaches. As a result, it is visually plausible as a massing study but not yet program-fit enough for the hard pass.
